original_query: Which achieved better performance in the year Nestlé acquired Prometheus, Organic Growth or Real Internal Growth?

summaries.found_via_query: Nestlé acquisition of Prometheus financial performance comparison Organic Growth vs Real Internal Growth
summaries.summary: This slide from Nestlé's 2011 Full Year Results Roadshow (February 21st, 2012) displays 10 years of organic growth and EBIT margin improvement, with a bar chart showing annual performance from 2001 to 2011. The chart includes Organic Growth (blue bars) and EBIT margin (gray line), with a note that data corresponds to published figures. The 10-year annual averages are 6.4% for Organic Growth and 3.6% for Real Internal Growth. The slide also shows a trend line for EBIT margin improving from 11.8% in 2001 to 15.0% in 2011.
